stampedlock-concept.title: StampedLock
stampedlock-concept.summary: StampedLock supports read, write, and optimistic read modes.
stampedlock-concept.why: It provides another coordination option for concurrent code.
stampedlock-concept.tips: Validate optimistic reads before using their results.

delayqueue-concept.title: DelayQueue
delayqueue-concept.summary: DelayQueue makes delayed elements available after their delay expires.
delayqueue-concept.why: It represents work that becomes eligible over time.
delayqueue-concept.tips: Keep delay and ordering rules consistent.

collections-newsetfrommap.title: Create a Set from a Map
collections-newsetfrommap.summary: Collections.newSetFromMap creates a Set backed by an empty Map.
collections-newsetfrommap.why: The Set can use the supplied Map's key behavior.
collections-newsetfrommap.tips: The supplied Map must be empty.

overlapping-file-lock-exception.title: Overlapping file locks
overlapping-file-lock-exception.summary: OverlappingFileLockException reports an overlapping lock request in one JVM.
overlapping-file-lock-exception.tips: Release an existing lock before acquiring an overlapping one.

unresolved-address-exception.title: Unresolved network addresses
unresolved-address-exception.summary: UnresolvedAddressException reports use of an unresolved address where a resolved address is required.
unresolved-address-exception.why: A connection needs a usable network address.

generic-exception-class-error.title: Generic exception class error
generic-exception-class-error.summary: Java rejects generic subclasses of Throwable.
generic-exception-class-error.why: Exception matching and erased type arguments do not support generic throwable classes.

annotation-element-type-error.title: Invalid annotation element type
annotation-element-type-error.short: Use a permitted annotation element type
annotation-element-type-error.summary: Annotation elements can use only the types permitted by the language rules.
annotation-element-type-error.why: Arbitrary object types such as List are not valid annotation element types.
annotation-element-type-error.tips: Use an array of a permitted type for multiple values.

varargs-heap-pollution-warning.title: Generic varargs warning
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.summary: Generic varargs can produce a compiler warning because their runtime array representation can lose type information.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.why: Generic type arguments are not fully retained at runtime.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.tips: Only suppress the warning after verifying the method is safe.

bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.title: BigDecimal equality and scale
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.summary: BigDecimal.equals considers scale, so numerically equal values can compare unequal with equals.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.why: Scale is part of BigDecimal equality.
bigdecimal-equals-scale-trap.tips: Use compareTo when only numeric equality matters.

weak-key-disappears-trap.title: WeakHashMap key lifetime
weak-key-disappears-trap.short: Remember that weak keys can be collected
weak-key-disappears-trap.summary: WeakHashMap entries can disappear when their keys no longer have other strong references.
weak-key-disappears-trap.why: The map keeps its keys through weak references.
weak-key-disappears-trap.tips: Keep another reference while a key must remain available.
